<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

This PR moves the DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash mono decode kernels of #60397 into a shared package, `vllm/models/common/amd/mono/`, and plugs DeepSeek-V4-Pro into the same kernels at TP8 on MI355X (gfx950). Pro adds no kernel code of its own. It uses a `MonoSpec` (widths, numerics, variant flags) and a `MonoDecode` subclass of about 300 lines. Opt-in with `--monokernel`, as for V4.1.

Related: RFC #60904. #61311 drafts the RFC's runtime layer (`vllm/models/common/mono/`: routing, fail-stop, guards) and leaves the kernel code to each model. This PR covers the other half: one set of FlyDSL kernel stages shared by two models. The two can coexist; see Details.

## Claims

- DeepSeek-V4-Pro, TP8, MI355X, InferenceX AgentX (`inferencex-agentx-mvp`, DSpark with 6 drafts, synthetic acceptance 3.77), mono on vs off:

  | | c1 off → on | c4 off → on | c8 off → on |
  | --- | --- | --- | --- |
  | Interactivity P50 (tok/s/user) | 241 → **299** (+24%) | 218 → **247** (+13%) | 192 → **201** (+5%) |
  | Interactivity P90, InferenceX's slow tail (tok/s/user) | 227 → **278** (+22%) | 169 → **176** (+5%) | 119 → **147** (+23%) |
  | Inter-token latency P50 (ms) | 4.16 → **3.34** (−20%) | 4.59 → **4.04** (−12%) | 5.20 → **4.96** (−5%) |
  | Output throughput (tok/s) | 87.8 → 93.8 | 144 → 194 | 292 → 302 |

  One 900 s run per point. AgentX replays agent sessions closed-loop, so a faster server completes a different mix of turns. Mean inter-token latency and total throughput therefore move with the prompt-length mix and with prefill stalls, not only with decode speed. For example, the c4 mono-on run happened to serve shorter contexts (mean input 136K vs 181K tokens). P90 at c4 / c8 mostly reflects stalls behind other users' long prefills, which run vLLM's own path. The P50 rows are the decode-speed comparison.

- GSM8K at TP8 matches mono off (see Validation).
- V4.1 builds the same kernels as on `main`: 48 of 48 variants are byte-identical, apart from one race fix in the combine stage of index-source layers. That fix was timed and shows no regression.
- One more model of this family needs a spec and a docking class, not a kernel fork. The package README has an "Adding a model" section.

## Validation

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `pytest tests/models/test_dsv4_mono_numerics.py` (TP8, MI355X) | 2 passed. Each stage checked against vLLM's own ops and an exact fp32 reference; CSA layers, and HCA layers at the 64K deployment's key-table width (512) and a long context's (2048); hash routing in the FFN launch; widths 7–56; one- and two-hop all-reduce; 200 graph replays. |
| `pytest tests/models/test_dsv4_mono_layers.py` (TP8, MI355X) | passed 5 of 5 runs. A five-layer Pro (hash HCA first layer, hash HCA, hash CSA, bias HCA, bias CSA) on random weights with `--monokernel` on vs off, every layer's outputs at every decode step. A 3% routed-scale error in the kernels fails it. |
| `pytest tests/models/test_dsv4_mono_decode.py` (CPU) | 25 passed: the docking's path choice and the startup refusals |
| `pytest tests/models/test_dsv41_mono_decode.py tests/models/test_dsv41_mono_numerics.py tests/models/test_dsv41_mono_layers.py` (TP2 / TP4) | pass |
| GSM8K, InferenceX `gsm8k.yaml`, chat, greedy, 1319 questions, TP8, real DSpark | mono off 0.9757 / 0.9765. Mono on 0.9750 / 0.9757 (before the HCA fix) and 0.9735 / 0.9742 (final). Flexible / strict; stderr 0.0044. |
| AgentX sweep (Claims) | one run per point, 900 s, fresh server per point |
| V4.1 ISA, 48 variants, `FLYDSL_DUMP_IR` + `COMPILE_ONLY` vs `main` | identical except the 6 index-source K2 variants (race fix) |
| V4.1 index-source K2 timing, race fix vs without, µs per layer (TP2 / TP4, 6–48 rows) | within ±1% run-to-run noise (A/B/A) |

<details>
<summary>Per-layer kernel bench (DeepSeek-V4-Pro, TP8, µs per layer, 8 layers back to back in one graph, cold weights)</summary>

| rows | CSA vLLM | CSA mono | HCA vLLM | HCA mono |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 7 | 195.7 | 125.3 | 197.8 | 123.6 |
| 14 | 216.6 | 170.4 | 215.6 | 169.1 |
| 28 | 261.5 | 242.4 | 259.1 | 239.3 |
| 56 | 345.3 | 356.5 (two-hop) | 338.1 | 344.3 (two-hop) |

The compressor and indexer run vLLM's own ops on both paths, so the bench excludes them.

</details>

CI: the existing MI355 V4.1 jobs now also depend on `vllm/models/common/amd/`. The Pro docking test runs in the MI355 Basic Models step, and a new `mi355_8` job runs the Pro numerics and layer tests. Neither runs in upstream CI without MI355 runners. Everything above ran on 8× MI355X.

## Details

- **Package layout.** `spec.py` holds `MonoSpec` and `Dims`, a rank's share of every width. `stages/` holds the mHC seam, MoE, router and all-reduce. `attention/` holds the sparse-MLA front and back. `layer.py` and `runner.py` hold the launches and host side. `decode.py` is the vLLM-side base class: deployment checks, step eligibility, record views. A variant is a spec flag read with `const_expr`, so each model's kernels are compiled only from its own flags:
  - `delayed_seam` (V4.1)
  - `q_head_norm`, `preshuffled`, `padded_rows` (Pro)
  - `two_hop_rows`
- **What Pro needs beyond V4.1:**
  - the non-delayed mHC seam (aiter's `mhc_pre` collapse)
  - a weightless per-head q RMSNorm
  - aiter's (16, 16)-preshuffled FP8 weights and `VLLM_ROCM_FP8_PADDING` row strides
  - hash routing for layers 0–2
  - HCA layers, which read every compressed row from vLLM's c128a table
  - 128×128 block scales, expanded exactly to the kernels' 32×32 E8M0 scales
- **HCA key table.** At a 1M context the table is 8192 rows wide. The key table, the split units and the combine stage cover only each token's own keys (`bounded`). Without this, an HCA layer took ~240 µs and mono was 10% slower end to end than mono off.
- **Two-hop all-reduce.** In `stages/allreduce.py`, each rank sends a column to its owner rank. The owner sums the ranks in order and sends the bf16 sum back out. This moves 2/tp of the bytes of the one-hop path and is bit-identical to it. It costs ~10 µs at 7 rows and saves ~20 µs at 56, so Pro enables it from 42 rows.
- **Race fix (V4.1 and Pro).** On index-source layers, K2's combine stage could read a token's key count before the CTA building that key table had published it. Combine now waits on the table's ready flag and reads the count at device scope.
- **Limits:**
  - Pro's compressor and indexer still run as vLLM ops between K1 and K2, serially, where vLLM overlaps them on side streams.
  - At 56 rows a layer is ~3% slower than vLLM in the kernel bench; AgentX c8 still gains.
  - TP8 only for Pro.
- **Relation to #61311 / #60731.**
  - This PR does not touch the runtime layer #61311 proposes. If it lands, `MonoDecode` here can become that PR's per-model glue.
  - #60731 (V4.1 on gfx942) edits the files this PR moves, so whichever lands second needs a rebase. The move is a pure `git mv` plus spec parameterization.
- AI assistance (Claude Code) was used for the implementation, the tests and this description. The human submitter reviews every changed line before this PR leaves draft.

---

+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The DeepSeek-V4-Pro mono decode layer runs only where its kernels are exact:
+decode-only steps of at most 64 rows with causal SWA windows, eager or in a
+FULL graph. Every backbone layer takes the whole layer: a CSA layer through
+its top-k (its compressor and indexer run between the launches), an HCA layer
+through every compressed row (vLLM's c128a table), a hash-routed layer with
+its tokens' experts. Deployments the kernels cannot run are an error."""
+
+import sys
+from types import ModuleType, SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.oracle.mxfp4 import Mxfp4MoeBackend
+from vllm.models.common.amd.mono import decode as dec
+from vllm.models.deepseek_v4.amd import mono_decode as md
+
+M = 6
+HIDDEN = md.SPEC.hidden
+HCA_WIDTH = 512
+DEFAULT = object()
+
+
+class _Runner:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.calls = []
+
+    def forward(self, *args, **kwargs):
+        self.calls.append((args, kwargs))
+        return ("x", "residual", "post_mix", "res_mix", "extra")
+
+    def first_pre_mix(self, rows):
+        return torch.zeros(rows, 4)
+
+
+def _cache(block):
+    return torch.zeros(4, block * dec.RECORD, dtype=torch.uint8)
+
+
+def _layer(ratio=md.CSA, tid2eid=None):
+    attn = SimpleNamespace(
+        prefix="comp",
+        swa_cache_layer=SimpleNamespace(prefix="swa", kv_cache=_cache(64)),
+        kv_cache=_cache(64),
+        compress_ratio=ratio,
+        topk_indices_buffer=torch.zeros(64, 1024, dtype=torch.int32),
+    )
+    ffn = SimpleNamespace(gate=SimpleNamespace(tid2eid=tid2eid))
+    return SimpleNamespace(attn=attn, ffn=ffn)
+
+
+def _swa(**overrides):
+    fields = dict(
+        num_prefills=0,
+        num_decodes=1,
+        num_decode_tokens=M,
+        decode_swa_width=dec.SWA_WIDTH,
+        decode_swa_indices=torch.zeros(64, 1, dec.SWA_WIDTH, dtype=torch.int32),
+        decode_swa_lens=torch.zeros(64, dtype=torch.int32),
+        token_to_req_indices=torch.zeros(64, dtype=torch.int32),
+        slot_mapping=torch.zeros(64, dtype=torch.int64),
+        block_size=64,
+    )
+    fields.update(overrides)
+    return SimpleNamespace(**fields)
+
+
+def _c128a(rows=M, width=128):
+    """VLLM's c128a decode table: its step's rows of a 64-row buffer as wide as
+    the longest context, cut to the step's active width."""
+    buffer = torch.arange(64 * HCA_WIDTH, dtype=torch.int32).view(64, HCA_WIDTH)
+    return buffer[:rows, :width].view(rows, 1, -1)
+
+
+def _comp(rows=M, **overrides):
+    fields = dict(
+        block_size=256,
+        block_table=torch.zeros(1, 4, dtype=torch.int32),
+        c128a_global_decode_topk_indices=_c128a(rows),
+    )
+    fields.update(overrides)
+    return SimpleNamespace(**fields)
+
+
+def _inputs(rows=M):
+    return dict(
+        x=torch.zeros(rows, 4, HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+        positions=torch.zeros(rows, dtype=torch.int64),
+        input_ids=torch.arange(rows),
+        residual=torch.zeros(rows, 4, HIDDEN, dtype=torch.bfloat16),
+        post_mix=torch.zeros(rows, 4, 1),
+        res_mix=torch.zeros(rows, 4, 4),
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def run(monkeypatch):
+    """Call the mono path for one layer under a forward context built from
+    ``mode`` and ``metadata``; returns (result, runner calls). ``run.built``
+    records the runner's build arguments."""
+    built: list = []
+
+    def _run(mode=CUDAGraphMode.FULL, metadata=DEFAULT, layer=None, **inputs):
+        if metadata is DEFAULT:
+            metadata = {"swa": _swa(), "comp": _comp()}
+        fc = SimpleNamespace(cudagraph_runtime_mode=mode, attn_metadata=metadata)
+        runner = _Runner()
+        monkeypatch.setattr(dec, "is_forward_context_available", lambda: True)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(dec, "get_forward_context", lambda: fc)
+
+        def build(*args):
+            built.append(args)
+            return runner
+
+        monkeypatch.setattr(dec, "mono_runner", build)
+        monkeypatch.setattr(md.MonoDecodeLayer, "weights", lambda self, layer: None)
+        mono = md.MonoDecodeLayer(HCA_WIDTH)
+        return mono(layer or _layer(), **{**_inputs(), **inputs}), runner.calls
+
+    _run.built = built  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    return _run
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("mode", [CUDAGraphMode.NONE, CUDAGraphMode.FULL])
+def test_csa_step_runs_mono_with_its_topk(run, mode):
+    layer = _layer()
+    out, calls = run(mode, layer=layer)
+    assert out == ("x", "residual", "post_mix", "res_mix") and len(calls) == 1
+    kwargs = calls[0][1]
+    assert kwargs["topk_indices"] is layer.attn.topk_indices_buffer
+    # the CSA cache: a 256-token page holds 64 compressed records
+    assert kwargs["comp_cache"].shape == (4, 64, dec.RECORD)
+    assert kwargs["fold"] and kwargs["route_ids"] is None
+    assert "global_keys" not in kwargs
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "ratio, indexed, expected",
+    [
+        (md.CSA, True, ["compressor", "indexer", "topk"]),
+        # a short context's top-k is every row, already filled
+        (md.CSA, False, ["compressor", "indexer"]),
+        (md.HCA, False, ["compressor"]),
+    ],
+    ids=["csa", "csa-short-context", "hca"],
+)
+def test_select_runs_the_compressor_then_the_indexer(run, ratio, indexed, expected):
+    """Between K1 and K2 the layer's compressor writes its row and a CSA
+    layer's indexer selects the top-k from K1's normed input and qr."""
+    log = []
+    normed = torch.empty(M, HIDDEN, device="meta")
+    qr = torch.empty(M, 1536, device="meta")
+    q = torch.empty(M, 4, device="meta") if indexed else None
+
+    class Compressor:
+        fused_wkv_wgate = SimpleNamespace(weight=torch.empty(8, HIDDEN, device="meta"))
+
+        def __call__(self, score, positions, rope):
+            log.append("compressor")
+
+    class Indexer:
+        compressor = Compressor()
+
+        def weights_proj(self, x):
+            return x[:, :4], None
+
+        def __call__(self, x, q_rank, score, weights, positions, rope):
+            assert x is normed and q_rank is qr
+            log.append("indexer")
+            return q, None, weights
+
+        def indexer_op(self, x, index_q, _, weights):
+            assert x is normed and index_q is q
+            log.append("topk")
+
+    layer = _layer(ratio)
+    layer.attn.compressor = Compressor()
+    layer.attn.indexer = Indexer() if ratio == md.CSA else None
+    layer.attn.rotary_emb = layer.attn.indexer_rotary_emb = None
+    _, calls = run(layer=layer)
+    calls[0][1]["select"](normed, qr)
+    assert log == expected
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("decode_tokens", [M, M - 2], ids=["exact", "padded"])
+def test_hca_step_reads_every_compressed_row(run, decode_tokens):
+    """An HCA layer's keys are its c128a table's rows: the runner is built as
+    wide as vLLM's table, and the kernels read the table's buffer at its row
+    stride. A FULL graph padded past the step's decode tokens reads its pad
+    rows from the same buffer (their slots are -1)."""
+    comp = _comp(rows=decode_tokens)
+    metadata = {"swa": _swa(num_decode_tokens=decode_tokens), "comp": comp}
+    out, calls = run(metadata=metadata, layer=_layer(ratio=md.HCA))
+    assert out is not None and len(calls) == 1
+    assert [args[2] for args in run.built] == [HCA_WIDTH]
+    kwargs = calls[0][1]
+    assert kwargs["global_keys"] and kwargs["topk"] == HCA_WIDTH
+    keys = kwargs["topk_indices"]
+    table = comp.c128a_global_decode_topk_indices
+    assert keys.data_ptr() == table.data_ptr() and keys.stride(0) == HCA_WIDTH
+    assert keys.untyped_storage().nbytes() >= M * HCA_WIDTH * keys.element_size()
+    assert kwargs["comp_cache"].shape == (4, 2, dec.RECORD)
+
+
+def test_hash_layer_routes_its_tokens(run):
+    tid2eid = torch.arange(100 * 6).view(100, 6)
+    ids = torch.tensor([3, 1, 4, 1, 5, 9])
+    out, calls = run(layer=_layer(tid2eid=tid2eid), input_ids=ids)
+    assert out is not None
+    assert torch.equal(calls[0][1]["route_ids"], tid2eid[ids])
+
+
+def test_first_layer_runs_mono_from_the_embedding(run):
+    """The first layer's residual is the embedding broadcast to the four
+    streams, which K1 takes as it is (no owed post to fold)."""
+    out, calls = run(residual=None, post_mix=None, res_mix=None)
+    assert out is not None and len(calls) == 1
+    args, kwargs = calls[0]
+    assert args[2] is args[1] and not kwargs["fold"]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "case",
+    [
+        dict(mode=CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE),
+        dict(metadata={"swa": _swa(num_prefills=1), "comp": _comp()}),
+        dict(metadata=None),  # a profile / dummy run
+        dict(metadata={"swa": _swa()}),
+        dict(
+            metadata={
+                "swa": _swa(),
+                "comp": _comp(c128a_global_decode_topk_indices=None),
+            },
+            layer=_layer(ratio=md.HCA),
+        ),
+        dict(**_inputs(md.SPEC.max_tokens + 1)),
+        dict(residual=torch.zeros(M, HIDDEN, 4, dtype=torch.bfloat16).mT),
+        dict(layer=_layer(tid2eid=torch.zeros(100, 6)), input_ids=None),
+    ],
+    ids=[
+        "piecewise",
+        "prefill",
+        "no-metadata",
+        "no-comp-metadata",
+        "no-c128a-metadata",
+        "rows",
+        "non-contiguous",
+        "hash-without-ids",
+    ],
+)
+def test_other_steps_take_the_original_path(run, case):
+    out, calls = run(**case)
+    assert out is None and not calls
+
+
+def _decoder_layer(layer_id=5, **attn):
+    attn = (
+        dict(
+            prefix=f"model.layers.{layer_id}.attn",
+            compress_ratio=md.CSA,
+            indexer=object(),
+            kv_cache_dtype="fp8_ds_mla",
+        )
+        | attn
+    )
+    quant_method = SimpleNamespace(mxfp4_backend=Mxfp4MoeBackend.AITER_MXFP4_BF16)
+    ffn = SimpleNamespace(
+        experts=SimpleNamespace(
+            routed_experts=SimpleNamespace(quant_method=quant_method)
+        ),
+        shared_experts=object(),
+        use_mega_moe=False,
+        fuse_heterogeneous_shared_expert=False,
+        is_fused_shared_expert_enabled=False,
+        gate=SimpleNamespace(tid2eid=None, bias_vl=None),
+        n_routed_experts=384,
+        n_activated_experts=6,
+        routed_scaling_factor=2.5,
+        swiglu_limit=10.0,
+        scoring_func="sqrtsoftplus",
+        renormalize=True,
+    )
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        attn=SimpleNamespace(**attn),
+        ffn=ffn,
+        use_fused_mhc=True,
+        fuse_mhc_rmsnorm=True,
+    )
+
+
+def _config(monokernel=True, max_model_len=8192):
+    parallel = dict(
+        enable_expert_parallel=False, enable_eplb=False, data_parallel_size=1
+    )
+    return SimpleNamespace(
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            hf_config=SimpleNamespace(num_hidden_layers=61),
+            max_model_len=max_model_len,
+        ),
+        parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(**parallel),
+        kernel_config=SimpleNamespace(monokernel=monokernel),
+    )
+
+
+def _deployment(monkeypatch, tp=8, aiter_linear=True):
+    """A deployment the kernels take (the runner module stubbed: no FlyDSL)."""
+    import vllm.platforms.rocm as rocm
+    from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
+
+    monkeypatch.delenv("VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE_A4W4_DSV4", raising=False)
+    monkeypatch.delenv("VLLM_ROCM_FP8_PADDING", raising=False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(rocm, "get_cdna_version", lambda: 4)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(dec, "get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size", lambda: tp)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(dec, "_compute_units", lambda: 256)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(
+        rocm_aiter_ops, "is_linear_fp8_enabled", classmethod(lambda cls: aiter_linear)
+    )
+    name = "vllm.models.common.amd.mono.runner"
+    runner = ModuleType(name)
+    runner.BLOCKS = 256  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+    monkeypatch.setitem(sys.modules, name, runner)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "layer, eligible",
+    [
+        (_decoder_layer(), True),
+        (_decoder_layer(compress_ratio=md.HCA, indexer=None), True),
+        (_decoder_layer(layer_id=61), False),
+    ],
+    ids=["csa", "hca", "draft"],
+)
+def test_backbone_layers_take_the_whole_layer(monkeypatch, layer, eligible):
+    _deployment(monkeypatch)
+    mono = md.MonoDecodeLayer.create(layer, _config())
+    assert (mono is not None) == eligible
+
+
+def test_off_without_the_flag(monkeypatch):
+    """No --monokernel: no mono layer, whatever the deployment."""
+    _deployment(monkeypatch, tp=4)
+    assert (
+        md.MonoDecodeLayer.create(_decoder_layer(), _config(monokernel=False)) is None
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "case, match",
+    [
+        (dict(tp=4), "tensor parallel size 8"),
+        (dict(aiter_linear=False), "VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_LINEAR"),
+        (dict(padding="0"), "VLLM_ROCM_FP8_PADDING"),
+    ],
+    ids=["tp", "aiter-linear", "fp8-padding"],
+)
+def test_opt_in_outside_the_kernels_raises(monkeypatch, case, match):
+    """The kernels read TP8 shards of vLLM's preshuffled, padded aiter FP8
+    weights: any other deployment is an error, not garbage."""
+    padding = case.get("padding")
+    _deployment(monkeypatch, **{k: v for k, v in case.items() if k != "padding"})
+    if padding is not None:
+        monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_FP8_PADDING", padding)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=match):
+        md.MonoDecodeLayer.create(_decoder_layer(), _config())
+
+
+def test_hca_key_table_is_vllms_c128a_width(monkeypatch):
+    """The runner's HCA key table is as wide as the c128a table vLLM's metadata
+    builder allocates: every compressed row of the longest context, in 128-row
+    multiples (sparse_mla)."""
+    _deployment(monkeypatch)
+    layer = _decoder_layer(compress_ratio=md.HCA, indexer=None)
+    mono = md.MonoDecodeLayer.create(layer, _config(max_model_len=1_000_000))
+    assert mono is not None and mono.max_topk == 7936

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The DeepSeek-V4-Pro mono decode path through the real model: a five-layer
+DeepSeek-V4-Pro at TP8 on CDNA4, served with ``--monokernel`` on and off on
+the same random weights: every decoder layer's outputs at every decode step
+must match. Unlike ``test_dsv4_mono_numerics.py``, which checks the kernels
+against vLLM's ops one stage at a time, this runs
+``DeepseekV4DecoderLayer.forward`` in the engine -- the model's hook, the
+per-step path choice, the weights taken off the layer, the metadata, the
+compressor and the indexer's top-k -- so a change to the decoder layer that
+the kernels do not follow fails here. Scope: eager steps of one token a
+request; speculative decoding's multi-token rows and graph replays are not
+covered.
+
+The checkpoint's own first five layers (``compress_ratios`` 128, 128, 4, 128,
+4; ``num_hash_layers`` 3) hold every variant the kernels build, each taking the
+whole layer (K1 + K2):
+- 0: hash-routed HCA, the first layer (K1 takes the embedding, no fold)
+- 1: hash-routed HCA
+- 2: hash-routed CSA (vLLM's indexer between K1 and K2)
+- 3: bias-routed HCA
+- 4: bias-routed CSA
+A 32K ``max_model_len`` builds the HCA kernels 256 keys wide; the prompts
+(under 8.3K) keep vLLM's c128a decode table at its 128-wide floor, so the
+kernels read a table narrower than they are built for.
+"""
+
+import zlib
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader import register_model_loader
+from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.dummy_loader import DummyModelLoader
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+MODEL = "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro"
+TP = 8
+LOAD_FORMAT = "dsv4_mono_random"
+TRUNCATED = {
+    "num_hidden_layers": 5,
+    # one entry a layer, the MTP layer's included
+    "compress_ratios": [128, 128, 4, 128, 4, 0],
+}
+LAYERS = (0, 1, 2, 3, 4)
+STEPS = 5  # decode steps after the prefill's token
+
+
+def _on_cdna4() -> bool:
+    if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+        return False
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import get_cdna_version
+
+    return get_cdna_version() == 4
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def _fill(name: str, t: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    """A random value for every weight, seeded by its name (alike on every
+    rank and in every run), in the ranges the checkpoint's formats hold."""
+    if t.device.type == "meta":
+        return  # materialized and filled by the dummy loader's own path
+    g = torch.Generator(device=t.device).manual_seed(zlib.crc32(name.encode()))
+
+    def randn(scale=1.0, shift=0.0):
+        return torch.randn(t.shape, generator=g, device=t.device) * scale + shift
+
+    if t.dtype in (torch.uint8, torch.float8_e8m0fnu) and "scale" in name:
+        # E8M0 2^-12 .. 2^-8: one a 128 x 128 FP8 block, one a 32 MXFP4
+        # values. Larger random layers make the stack chaotic: atomics' order
+        # alone moves vLLM's own logits run to run.
+        u8 = t.view(torch.uint8)
+        u8.copy_(torch.randint(115, 120, u8.shape, generator=g, device=t.device))
+    elif t.dtype in (torch.uint8, torch.float4_e2m1fn_x2):
+        u8 = t.view(torch.uint8)
+        u8.copy_(torch.randint(0, 256, u8.shape, generator=g, device=t.device))
+    elif t.dtype == torch.float8_e4m3fn:
+        t.copy_(randn().clamp(-6, 6))
+    elif name.endswith("tid2eid"):
+        # a hash layer's table: distinct experts (of 384) a token
+        ids = torch.rand(t.shape[0], 384, generator=g, device=t.device)
+        t.copy_(ids.argsort(1)[:, : t.shape[1]])
+    elif not torch.is_floating_point(t):
+        return
+    elif "norm" in name:
+        t.copy_(randn(0.1, 1.0))
+    elif name.endswith(("hc_attn_scale", "hc_ffn_scale")):
+        t.copy_(randn(0.5).abs() + 0.5)
+    elif name.endswith(("hc_attn_base", "hc_ffn_base", "attn_sink")):
+        t.copy_(randn(0.1))
+    elif name.endswith("embed_tokens.weight"):
+        t.copy_(randn())
+    else:
+        t.copy_(randn(0.02))
+
+
+@register_model_loader(LOAD_FORMAT)
+class RandomWeightLoader(DummyModelLoader):
+    """Dummy loading with weights in the checkpoint's ranges, before post-load
+    processing, so every processed copy follows (plain dummy weights leave the
+    E8M0 scales zero, and both paths would agree on zeros)."""
+
+    def load_weights(self, model, model_config) -> None:
+        from vllm.distributed import get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size
+
+        super().load_weights(model, model_config)
+        for name, t in model.state_dict().items():
+            _fill(name, t)
+        # the routed experts' intermediate past this rank's share, if padded,
+        # is the loader's zero padding: the kernels skip it
+        inter = model_config.hf_text_config.moe_intermediate_size
+        inter //= get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+        for m in model.modules():
+            w13, w2 = getattr(m, "w13_weight", None), getattr(m, "w2_weight", None)
+            if w13 is None or w2 is None or w13.device.type == "meta":
+                continue
+            padded = w13.shape[1] // 2
+            if padded > inter:
+                w13, w2 = w13.data.view(torch.uint8), w2.data.view(torch.uint8)
+                for half in (0, padded):
+                    w13[:, half + inter : half + padded] = 0
+                w2[..., inter // 2 :] = 0
+
+
+class MonoProbe:
+    """Worker extension (``worker_extension_cls``): it also brings this module,
+    and so the loader, into the workers."""
+
+    def _decoder_layers(self) -> dict:
+        from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import extract_layer_index
+        from vllm.models.deepseek_v4.amd.model import DeepseekV4DecoderLayer
+
+        model = self.model_runner.model  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+        return {
+            extract_layer_index(m.attn.prefix): m
+            for m in model.modules()
+            if isinstance(m, DeepseekV4DecoderLayer)
+        }
+
+    def capture_steps(self, lens: list[int]) -> None:
+        """Keep each decoder layer's outputs (x, residual, post_mix, res_mix)
+        for every decode token taken in a decode-only step (the steps the
+        mono path takes), keyed by (layer, prompt length, position): a
+        request's step and row can differ between engines, its prompt length
+        and position cannot.
+        ``lens``: the prompt lengths, more than ``STEPS`` apart; a row's
+        request is the longest prompt not past its position."""
+        from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+
+        self._captured: dict = {}
+        self._gaps: dict = {}
+        lens = sorted(lens)
+
+        def decode_only(layer) -> bool:
+            md = get_forward_context().attn_metadata
+            if not isinstance(md, dict):
+                return False
+            swa = md.get(layer.attn.swa_cache_layer.prefix)
+            return swa is not None and swa.num_prefills == 0
+
+        def keys(layer_id, pos):
+            for row, p in enumerate(pos.tolist()):
+                yield row, (layer_id, max(n for n in lens if n <= p), p)
+
+        def hook(layer_id):
+            def keep(module, args, kwargs, out):
+                if not decode_only(module):
+                    return
+                pos = kwargs.get("positions", args[1] if len(args) > 1 else None)
+                for row, k in keys(layer_id, pos):
+                    kept = [t[row].float().cpu() for t in out[:4]]
+                    self._captured.setdefault(k, kept)
+

+"""Numerics of the DeepSeek-V4-Pro mono decode kernels at TP8 on CDNA4 against
+the ops vLLM runs for the same decode step: random weights in the checkpoint's
+formats (FP8 128 x 128 blocks, MXFP4 experts), processed as vLLM processes
+them (aiter's preshuffled shared gate_up, its routed experts' layout).

+  attention op chain (block-scaled FP8 GEMMs, the fused q norm / RoPE / KV
+  insert, the sparse MLA, the inverse-RoPE MXFP8 wo_a BMM), the TP
+  all-reduce and ``DeepseekV4MoE``, on a CSA layer (its top-k) and an HCA one
+  (every compressed row).

+  on a bias-routed layer and a hash-routed one.
+
+Each stage is compared on its own input, so a failure names the stage. The
+kernels quantize activations as MXFP8 (E8M0 a 32), where vLLM's FP8 GEMMs take
+fp32 scales a 128: where the two differ by more than rounding, each is

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- caches

+
+def _paged_cache(num_blocks: int, block: int, device) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """[blocks, block, 584] u8 over pages of round_up(block * 584, 576) bytes,
+    the way vLLM binds a packed V4 cache."""
+    page = -(-block * RECORD // ALIGN) * ALIGN
+    raw = torch.zeros(num_blocks * page, dtype=torch.uint8, device=device)
+    return torch.as_strided(raw, (num_blocks, block, RECORD), (page, RECORD, 1))
+
+
+def _clone_cache(cache: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    raw = torch.as_strided(cache, (cache.shape[0] * cache.stride(0),), (1,)).clone()
+    return torch.as_strided(raw, cache.shape, cache.stride())
+
+
+def _rope(kv: torch.Tensor, positions: torch.Tensor, cos_sin: torch.Tensor):
+    """GPT-J RoPE of the last 64 dims (fp32 math) of rows [n, 512] or heads
+    [n, h, 512]."""
+    cs = cos_sin[positions.long()]
+    if kv.dim() == 3:
+        cs = cs[:, None]
+    cos, sin = cs[..., :32], cs[..., 32:]
+    x = kv.float()
+    e, o = x[..., NOPE::2].clone(), x[..., NOPE + 1 :: 2].clone()
+    x[..., NOPE::2] = e * cos - o * sin
+    x[..., NOPE + 1 :: 2] = e * sin + o * cos
+    return x
+
+
+def _write_records(cache, block: int, slots, kv):
+    """fp8_ds_mla records of roped bf16 kv rows at ``slots``: the 448 nope dims
+    in e4m3 with a UE8M0 per 64, the rope dims in bf16, as vLLM's insert."""
+    nope = kv.float()[:, :NOPE].view(-1, 7, 64)
+    exp = torch.ceil(torch.log2(nope.abs().amax(-1).clamp_min(1e-4) / 448.0))
+    q = (nope * torch.exp2(-exp)[..., None]).clamp(-448, 448).reshape(-1, NOPE)
+    data = torch.cat(
+        [
+            q.to(torch.float8_e4m3fn).view(torch.uint8),
+            kv[:, NOPE:].to(torch.bfloat16).contiguous().view(torch.uint8),
+        ],
+        1,
+    )
+    scales = torch.zeros(kv.shape[0], 8, dtype=torch.uint8, device=kv.device)
+    scales[:, :7] = (exp + 127).clamp(0, 255).to(torch.uint8)
+    flat, d0, s0 = _record_offsets(cache, block, slots)
+    ar = torch.arange(DATA, device=kv.device)
+    flat[(d0[:, None] + ar).reshape(-1)] = data.reshape(-1)
+    ar = torch.arange(8, device=kv.device)
+    flat[(s0[:, None] + ar).reshape(-1)] = scales.reshape(-1)
+
+
+def _record_offsets(cache, block: int, slots):
+    n = cache.untyped_storage().nbytes() - cache.storage_offset()
+    flat = torch.as_strided(cache, (n,), (1,))
+    slots = slots.to(cache.device).long()
+    b, o = slots // block, slots % block
+    return (
+        flat,
+        b * cache.stride(0) + o * DATA,
+        b * cache.stride(0) + block * DATA + o * 8,
+    )
+
+
+def _read_records(cache, block: int, slots) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The fp32 key rows of the records at ``slots``."""
+    flat, d0, s0 = _record_offsets(cache, block, slots)
+    data = flat[(d0[:, None] + torch.arange(DATA, device=cache.device)).reshape(-1)]
+    data = data.view(-1, DATA)
+    sc = flat[(s0[:, None] + torch.arange(7, device=cache.device)).reshape(-1)]
+    nope = data[:, :NOPE].contiguous().view(torch.float8_e4m3fn).float().view(-1, 7, 64)
+    nope = nope * torch.exp2(sc.view(-1, 7).float() - 127)[..., None]
+    rope = data[:, NOPE:].contiguous().view(torch.bfloat16).float()
+    return torch.cat([nope.reshape(-1, NOPE), rope], 1)

+def _normed_kv(n: int, kv_norm, g, device):
+    x = torch.randn(n, HEAD_DIM, generator=g).to(device)
+    x = x * torch.rsqrt(x.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True)) * kv_norm.float()

+def _decode_step(ratio: int, R: int, T: int, kv_norm, cos_sin, seed: int):

+    vLLM's builders lay it out, its window rows and the compressed cache

+def _keys(s: dict, i: int, ratio: int) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:

+
+    w = torch.randn(n, k, generator=g).clamp(-6, 6).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    s = torch.randint(116, 121, (n // 128, k // 128), generator=g).float()
+    return _maybe_pad_fp8_weight(w.to(device)), torch.exp2(s - 127).to(device)
+
+
+def _deq(w: torch.Tensor, s: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return w.float() * s.repeat_interleave(128, 0).repeat_interleave(128, 1)

+class _ExactMoE:
+    """A MoE layer's output on this rank in fp32 from its weights as loaded
+    (before post-load processing reshuffles them): MXFP4 / FP8 dequantized,
+    activations unquantized, vLLM's routing."""
+
+    FP4 = (0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4, 6, -0.0, -0.5, -1, -1.5, -2, -3, -4, -6)
+
+    def __init__(self, moe):
+        e = moe.experts.routed_experts
+        u8 = torch.uint8
+        self.moe = moe
+        self.w13 = (
+            e.w13_weight.data.view(u8).clone(),
+            e.w13_weight_scale.data.view(u8).clone(),
+        )
+        self.w2 = (
+            e.w2_weight.data.view(u8).clone(),
+            e.w2_weight_scale.data.view(u8).clone(),
+        )
+        self.lut = torch.tensor(self.FP4, device=e.w13_weight.device)
+
+    def shared(self, sh) -> None:
+        """The shared expert's weights, after their scales' upcast."""
+
+        def deq(lin):
+            w, sc = lin.weight.float(), lin.weight_scale_inv.float()
+            return w * sc.repeat_interleave(128, 0).repeat_interleave(128, 1)
+
+        self.sgu, self.sd = deq(sh.gate_up_proj), deq(sh.down_proj)
+
+    def _experts(self, raw, ids):
+        w, sc = raw[0][ids], raw[1][ids]
+        lo, hi = self.lut[(w & 15).long()], self.lut[(w >> 4).long()]
+        v = torch.stack([lo, hi], -1).flatten(-2)
+        return v * torch.exp2(sc.float() - 127).repeat_interleave(32, -1)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _swiglu(gu):
+        n = gu.shape[-1] // 2
+        g, u = gu[..., :n].clamp(max=10), gu[..., n:].clamp(-10, 10)
+        return torch.nn.functional.silu(g) * u
+
+    def __call__(self, x: torch.Tensor, route: torch.Tensor | None) -> torch.Tensor:
+        moe, x = self.moe, x.float()
+        scores = torch.nn.functional.softplus(x @ moe.gate.weight.float().T).sqrt()
+        if route is None:
+            bias = moe.gate.e_score_correction_bias
+            ids = (scores + bias).topk(moe.n_activated_experts, dim=1).indices
+        else:
+            ids = route.long()
+        w = scores.gather(1, ids)
+        w = w / w.sum(1, keepdim=True) * moe.routed_scaling_factor
+        out = self._swiglu(x @ self.sgu.T) @ self.sd.T
+        for t in range(x.shape[0]):
+            w13, w2 = self._experts(self.w13, ids[t]), self._experts(self.w2, ids[t])
+            act = self._swiglu(torch.einsum("knh,h->kn", w13, x[t]))
+            out[t] += (w[t, :, None] * torch.einsum("khn,kn->kh", w2, act)).sum(0)
+        return out
+

+def _check_ffn(rank: int, tp: int, device) -> None:
+    from vllm.config import set_current_vllm_config
+    from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group, tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce
+    from vllm.engine.arg_utils import EngineArgs
+    from vllm.forward_context import set_forward_context
+    from vllm.model_executor.kernels.mhc.torch import mhc_pre_torch
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.mhc import MHCFusedPostPreOp
+    from vllm.model_executor.model_loader.utils import process_weights_after_loading
+    from vllm.models.common.amd.mono.decode import mx_scales
+    from vllm.models.common.amd.mono.layer import scratch_layout
+    from vllm.models.common.amd.mono.runner import MonoLayerWeights, MonoRunner
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v4.amd.model import DeepseekV4MoE
+    from vllm.models.deepseek_v4.amd.mono_decode import SPEC
+    from vllm.utils.torch_utils import set_default_torch_dtype
+
+    vc = EngineArgs(
+        model=MODEL,
+        tensor_parallel_size=tp,
+        moe_backend="aiter",
+        load_format="dummy",
+        max_model_len=65536,
+        trust_remote_code=True,
+    ).create_engine_config()
+    cfg = vc.model_config.hf_config
+    bf = torch.bfloat16
+    g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1000)
+    runner = MonoRunner(SPEC, tp, rank, get_tp_group().cpu_group, device)
+    with set_current_vllm_config(vc):
+        fused = MHCFusedPostPreOp()
+
+    def f32(*shape, s=1.0, gen=g):
+        return (torch.randn(*shape, generator=gen) * s).to(device)
+
+    mix = (2 + HC) * HC
+    fn, scale, base = (
+        f32(mix, HC * HIDDEN, s=0.01),
+        f32(3, s=0.5).abs() + 0.5,
+        f32(mix, s=0.1),
+    )
+    norm = (1 + f32(HIDDEN, s=0.1)).to(bf)
+
+    steps = []
+    for layer in (3, 0):  # a bias-routed layer, then a hash-routed one
+        with set_current_vllm_config(vc), set_default_torch_dtype(bf), device:
+            moe = DeepseekV4MoE(vc, prefix=f"model.layers.{layer}.ffn")
+        _random_moe(
+            moe,
+            torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(2001 + rank + 10 * layer),
+            torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(2000 + layer),
+            cfg.vocab_size,
+        )
+        exact = _ExactMoE(moe)  # the weights as loaded, before processing
+        process_weights_after_loading(moe, vc.model_config, device)
+        sh = moe.shared_experts
+        exact.shared(sh)
+        sh.prepare_gateup_preshuffle()
+        assert sh._gateup_scale is not None, "the shared gate_up is not preshuffled"
+        e = moe.experts.routed_experts
+        hashed = moe.gate.tid2eid is not None
+        mw = MonoLayerWeights(
+            attn=None,
+            hc_attn_fn=fn, hc_attn_scale=scale, hc_attn_base=base, attn_norm=norm,
+            hc_ffn_fn=fn, hc_ffn_scale=scale, hc_ffn_base=base, ffn_norm=norm,
+            gate_w=moe.gate.weight, bias=moe.gate.e_score_correction_bias,
+            w13=e.w13_weight, w13_s=e.w13_weight_scale, w2=e.w2_weight,
+            w2_s=e.w2_weight_scale, sgu=sh.gate_up_proj.weight,
+            sgu_s=mx_scales(sh._gateup_scale, 128), sw2=sh.down_proj.weight,
+            sw2_s=mx_scales(sh.down_proj.weight_scale_inv, 128),
+        )  # fmt: skip
+        mw.check(runner.d)
+
+        def moe_out(x, ids, moe=moe):
+            with set_forward_context(None, vc):
+                return moe(x.clone(), ids)
+
+        for M in (7, 28, 56):
+            gi = torch.Generator().manual_seed(11 + M)
+            res = torch.randn(M, HC, HIDDEN, generator=gi)
+            res = (res * torch.rsqrt(res.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True))).to(bf)
+            res = res.to(device)
+            comb = torch.rand(M, HC, HC, generator=gi) + 0.1
+            for _ in range(20):
+                comb = comb / comb.sum(-1, keepdim=True)
+                comb = comb / comb.sum(-2, keepdim=True)
+            comb = comb.to(device)
+            post = (torch.sigmoid(torch.randn(M, HC, 1, generator=gi)) * 2).to(device)
+            # this rank's share of the attention output: its sum over the ranks
+            gp = torch.Generator().manual_seed(500 + M + 7 * rank)
+            part = (torch.randn(M, HIDDEN, generator=gp) * 0.2).to(bf).to(device)
+            ids = torch.randint(0, cfg.vocab_size, (M,), generator=gi).to(device)
+            route = moe.gate.tid2eid[ids].contiguous() if hashed else None
+
+            # vLLM's decode chain
+            a = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(part.clone())
+            with set_current_vllm_config(vc):
+                res2, post2, comb2, xf = fused(
+                    a, res, post, comb, fn, scale, base, cfg.rms_norm_eps,
+                    cfg.hc_eps, cfg.hc_eps, 2.0, cfg.hc_sinkhorn_iters,
+                    norm_weight=norm, norm_eps=cfg.rms_norm_eps,
+                )  # fmt: skip
+            out = moe_out(xf, ids)
+
+            # the FFN launch
+            pre_dummy = torch.zeros(M, HC, device=device)
+            f = runner.ffn(mw, part, res, post, comb, pre_dummy, route_ids=route)
+            tag = f"layer {layer}, M {M}"
+            # the seam: the residual vLLM's; the gate's mixes the fp32 reference
+            # of that residual's (aiter's fused seam is ~2e-3 off it: post / comb
+            # only loosely against vLLM's)
+            pm, cm, _ = mhc_pre_torch(
+                f[1], fn, scale, base, cfg.rms_norm_eps, cfg.hc_eps, cfg.hc_eps,
+                2.0, cfg.hc_sinkhorn_iters,
+            )  # fmt: skip
+            torch.testing.assert_close(f[1], res2, rtol=2**-7, atol=1e-5)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(f[2].view_as(pm), pm, rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(f[3].view_as(cm), cm, rtol=1e-4, atol=1e-5)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(f[2].view_as(post2), post2, rtol=0, atol=1e-2)
+            torch.testing.assert_close(f[3].view_as(comb2), comb2, rtol=0, atol=1e-2)
+            # the MoE on the kernels' own FFN input (where routing cannot differ),
+            # that input against vLLM's
+            off = scratch_layout(SPEC, M, tp)["normed"][0]
+            normed = runner.scratch(M)[off : off + M * HIDDEN * 2].view(bf)
+            normed = normed.view(M, HIDDEN)
+            assert _cos(normed, xf) > 0.999 and _rel(normed, xf) < 0.02, tag
+            same_in = moe_out(normed, ids)
+            # both against the exact MoE of that input (fp32, unquantized
+            # activations): the kernels' MXFP8 / bf16 roundings are not vLLM's
+            # (its shared expert quantizes per 128 with fp32 scales), so they
+            # must be as close to it as vLLM is, and near vLLM's
+            ref = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(exact(normed, route))
+            err_v, err_m = _rel(same_in, ref), _rel(f[0], ref)
+            assert err_m < 1.1 * err_v + 2e-3, (tag, err_m, err_v)
+            assert _cos(f[0], same_in) > 0.999 and _rel(f[0], same_in) < 0.03, tag
+            assert _cos(f[0], out) > 0.99, tag
+            outs = runner._outs(M, res)
+
+            def step(mw=mw, part=part, res=res, post=post, comb=comb,
+                     pre=pre_dummy, route=route, outs=outs):  # fmt: skip
+                runner.ffn(mw, part, res, post, comb, pre, outs=outs, route_ids=route)
+                return list(outs)
+
+            steps.append(step)
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+
+    # the hand-off protocol under back-to-back launches: every width and layer
+    # in one graph, every replay bit for bit the first's
+    outs = [t for step in steps for t in step()]
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    ref = [t.clone() for t in outs]
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        for step in steps:
+            step()
+    for i in range(REPLAYS):
+        graph.replay()
+        if i % 50 == 49 or i == REPLAYS - 1:
+            torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+            bad = [
+                j for j, (t, r) in enumerate(zip(outs, ref)) if not torch.equal(t, r)
+            ]
+            assert not bad, f"replay {i}: outputs {bad} differ from the first run"
+

+class _ExactAttention:
+    """A layer's attention on this rank in fp32 from its normed input: the
+    weights dequantized, the keys as a cache holds them (the window's rows of
+    the step written by the path under test), wo_b's partial out."""
+
+    def __init__(self, w: dict, eps: float, sink: torch.Tensor):
+        self.wqkv = _deq(w["wqkv"], w["wqkv_s"])
+        self.wq_b = _deq(w["wq_b"], w["wq_b_s"])
+        self.wo_a = _deq(w["wo_a"], w["wo_a_s"])
+        self.wo_b = _deq(w["wo_b"], w["wo_b_s"])
+        self.q_norm, self.kv_norm = w["q_norm"].float(), w["kv_norm"].float()
+        self.eps, self.sink = eps, sink.float()
+
+    def _rms(self, x, w):
+        return x * torch.rsqrt(x.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True) + self.eps) * w
+
+    def kv(self, x, positions, cos_sin) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """The KV rows of a step's tokens: kv_norm, then RoPE."""
+        kv = (x.float() @ self.wqkv.T)[:, Q_RANK:]
+        return _rope(self._rms(kv, self.kv_norm), positions, cos_sin)
+
+    def __call__(self, x, s: dict, ratio: int, swa_cache, cos_sin) -> torch.Tensor:
+        M, pos = x.shape[0], s["positions"]
+        qr_kv = x.float() @ self.wqkv.T
+        q = (self._rms(qr_kv[:, :Q_RANK], self.q_norm) @ self.wq_b.T).view(M, -1, 512)
+        q = _rope(self._rms(q, 1.0), pos, cos_sin)
+        heads = q.shape[1]
+        o = torch.empty(M, heads, HEAD_DIM, device=x.device)
+        for i in range(M):
+            top, win = _keys(s, i, ratio)
+            k = torch.cat(
+                [
+                    _read_records(s["comp_cache"], s["comp_entries"], top),
+                    _read_records(swa_cache, SWA_BLOCK, win),
+                ]
+            )
+            sc = (q[i] @ k.T) * HEAD_DIM**-0.5
+            m = torch.maximum(sc.amax(1), self.sink[:heads])
+            p = torch.exp(sc - m[:, None])
+            den = p.sum(1) + torch.exp(self.sink[:heads] - m)
+            o[i] = (p @ k) / den[:, None]
+        # inverse RoPE of each head's last 64 dims
+        cs = cos_sin[pos.long()][:, None]
+        cos, sin = cs[..., :32], cs[..., 32:]
+        e, od = o[..., NOPE::2].clone(), o[..., NOPE + 1 :: 2].clone()
+        o[..., NOPE::2] = e * cos + od * sin
+        o[..., NOPE + 1 :: 2] = od * cos - e * sin
+        groups = self.wo_a.shape[0] // O_RANK
+        og = o.view(M, groups, -1)
+        z = torch.einsum("mgk,gnk->mgn", og, self.wo_a.view(groups, O_RANK, -1))
+        return z.reshape(M, -1) @ self.wo_b.T
+
+
+def _attn_output(runner, epoch: int, M: int, rank: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """The wo_b partials every rank pushed to this rank's ATTN region in the
+    launch pair of ``epoch``, summed: [M, hidden] fp32. On two hops a rank
+    holds its own columns' partials only: the ranks' columns gathered."""
+    from vllm.distributed import tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce
+    from vllm.models.common.amd.mono.layer import peer_half_bytes
+
+    half = peer_half_bytes(runner.spec, runner.tp)
+    n = runner.tp * M * HIDDEN // 2
+    base = (epoch & 1) * half
+    pairs = runner.peer.bytes[base : base + n * 8].view(torch.int32).view(n, 2)
+    parts = pairs[:, 0].contiguous().view(torch.bfloat16).view(runner.tp, M, HIDDEN)
+    out = parts.float().sum(0)
+    if runner.two_hop(M):
+        cols = slice(rank * HIDDEN // runner.tp, (rank + 1) * HIDDEN // runner.tp)
+        own = torch.zeros_like(out)
+        own[:, cols] = out[:, cols]
+        out = tensor_model_parallel_all_reduce(own)
+    return out
+

+    def moe_out(x):
+        with set_forward_context(None, vc):
+            ids = torch.zeros(x.shape[0], dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+            return moe(x.clone(), ids)
+
+    # the attention's weights, as vLLM holds them after loading and its
+    # preshuffle (wqkv and wo_b shuffled in place, scales fp32)
+    w = {}
+    w["wqkv"], w["wqkv_s"] = _fp8_block(Q_RANK + HEAD_DIM, HIDDEN, g, device)
+    w["wq_b"], w["wq_b_s"] = _fp8_block(H * HEAD_DIM, Q_RANK, gs, device)
+    w["wo_a"], w["wo_a_s"] = _fp8_block(G * O_RANK, H // G * HEAD_DIM, gs, device)
+    w["wo_b"], w["wo_b_s"] = _fp8_block(HIDDEN, G * O_RANK, gs, device)
+    w["q_norm"] = (1 + f32(Q_RANK, s=0.1)).to(bf)
+    w["kv_norm"] = (1 + f32(HEAD_DIM, s=0.1)).to(bf)
+    sink = f32(H, gen=gs)
+    wqkv_sh = ops.shuffle_weight(w["wqkv"], layout=(16, 16))
+    wo_b_sh = ops.shuffle_weight(w["wo_b"], layout=(16, 16))
+    wo_a_e8m0 = mx_scales(w["wo_a_s"], 128)[::4, ::4].contiguous()
+    exact_attn = _ExactAttention(w, eps, sink)
+
+    steps = []
+    for ratio, R, T, width in (
+        (4, 1, 7, 0),
+        (128, 8, 7, hca_long),
+        (128, 2, 7, hca_dep),
+        (4, 4, 7, 0),
+    ):
+        with set_current_vllm_config(VllmConfig()):
+            rope = build_deepseek_v4_rope(
+                cfg, head_dim=HEAD_DIM, rope_head_dim=ROPE,
+                max_position_embeddings=cfg.max_position_embeddings,
+                compress_ratio=ratio,
+            )  # fmt: skip
+        cos_sin = rope.cos_sin_cache.to(device=device, dtype=torch.float32)
+        cos_bf, sin_bf = (c.contiguous() for c in cos_sin.to(bf).chunk(2, dim=-1))
+        s = _decode_step(ratio, R, T, w["kv_norm"], cos_sin, seed=7 + ratio + R)
+        M, tag = s["M"], f"ratio {ratio}, {R} x {T}, width {width}"

+                wq_b_scale=mx_scales(w["wq_b_s"], 128), wo_a=w["wo_a"],
+                wo_a_scale=mx_scales(w["wo_a_s"], 128), wo_b=wo_b_sh,

+            hc_attn_base=seams["attn"]["base"], attn_norm=seams["attn"]["norm"],

+        # the layer's inputs at the attention seam (the same on every rank)

+        res0 = torch.randn(M, HC, HIDDEN, generator=gi)
+        res0 = (res0 * torch.rsqrt(res0.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True))).to(bf)
+        res0 = res0.to(device)

+        comb0 = torch.rand(M, HC, HC, generator=gi) + 0.1

@@ -0,0 +1,165 @@
+# Mono decode layer (gfx950, FlyDSL)
+
+One fused decoder layer for vLLM's decode steps on MI355X: the attention seam,
+the attention, the attention all-reduce, the FFN seam, the MoE and the MoE
+all-reduce, in two persistent launches a layer. This package is the shared
+implementation; a model docks onto it with a `MonoSpec` and a `MonoDecode`
+subclass (see "Adding a model"):
+
+| model | docking | TP | layers |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash | `models/deepseek_v41/amd/mono_decode.py` | 2, 4 | all 40 (ratio 0 / 1 / 2, index sources, Engram) |
+| DeepSeek-V4-Pro | `models/deepseek_v4/amd/mono_decode.py` | 8 | all 61 (CSA ratio 4, HCA ratio 128, 3 hash layers) |
+
+A layer outside the whole-layer kernels keeps vLLM's attention and runs the
+rest -- the attention all-reduce, the FFN seam, the MoE and its all-reduce --
+as one launch (the FFN launch). ATOM's V4.1 mono decode
+(ROCm/ATOM `atom/models/deepseek_v41/mono`) is the reference design: the seam
+and MoE stages (`stages/`) and the framework under them (`common/`) are adapted
+from it, each file naming its origin; the attention stages (`attention/`) are
+new, reading vLLM's KV records and weights as loaded.
+
+## Layout
+
+    spec.py       MonoSpec (a model's layer: widths, numerics, variants) and
+                  Dims (a TP rank's share and every count derived from it)
+    common/       the execution model and build keys (plan), wave / math ops,
+                  the tagged mailbox (sync), MX arithmetic, peer memory
+    stages/       the mHC seams (seam), the FP8 GEMV (gemv), the MoE: router,
+                  route (bias top-k or hash), shared expert, routed ug / down
+                  (moe, moe_shape, moe_plan, router), the in-kernel all-reduce
+                  of the attention and MoE outputs (allreduce)
+    attention/    the DeepSeek-V4 family's sparse MLA: K1's front (wqkv, q / kv
+                  norms, KV insert, wq_b), K2's back (split attention over the
+                  key table, combine, wo_a, wo_b), their GEMV and plan
+    layer.py      the launches: K1, K2 and the FFN launch, from a MonoBuild
+                  (spec, step width, TP, the layer's variant)
+    runner.py     the host side: buffers, peer memory, the kernels a build key,
+                  the launches' arguments (MonoRunner, the weights' checks)
+    decode.py     vLLM's side every model shares: the deployment, the runner
+                  of a spec, a step's eligibility, the caches as records
+    sources.py    the package's source digest, in every build's JIT cache key
+
+## Scope
+
+- Steps: decode only (FULL graph or eager), at most `spec.max_tokens` rows
+  (V4.1: 48 = 8 requests x 6 DSpark tokens; V4-Pro: 64 >= 8 x 7), the TP sizes
+  of the docking, `fp8_ds_mla` KV records (ROCm). The DSpark / MTP draft
+  layers keep vLLM's path; the paths interleave freely (same tensors at the
+  layer boundary).
+- Contract: a drop-in for the decoder layer's forward: in the previous FFN
+  output (reduced) and the residual streams with their owed post / comb mixes
+  (V4.1 also the previous seam's pre-mix: its seams are delayed); out the MoE
+  output (reduced), the residual after the FFN seam, and that seam's mixes.
+- Between K1 and K2 a layer may hand vLLM its normed input and bf16 qr
+  (`select`): V4.1's index sources run their compressor and indexer there;
+  every V4-Pro layer runs its compressor (and a CSA layer its indexer). K2
+  then builds the key table: the top-k through the block table, or (an HCA
+  layer, `global_keys`) every compressed row from vLLM's c128a table, as wide
+  as the longest context (8192 at 1M): its rounds, split chunks and combine
+  cover a token's own keys only (`bounded`).
+
+## Launches
+
+    K1  seam (stages/seam.py): slice (hidden / 32 tasks): fold x into the
+        residual (post x + sum comb r), partial mixes (fn . R') and sums of
+        squares -> gate (S): 24 mixes -> pre / post / comb (Sinkhorn 20) ->
+        norm (S): the collapse (pre . R': the slice's with the incoming pre on a
+        delayed seam, the gate's own otherwise), attn_norm -> MXFP8 -> X8
+        attention front (attention/front.py): wqkv, q / kv norms + KV insert,
+        wq_b + RoPE -> Q
+    K2  attention back (attention/back.py): split attention (a head's q norm
+        scaling its scores, V4), combine + inverse RoPE, wo_a, wo_b; the bf16
+        wo_b partial pushed to every rank
+        FFN seam: reduce (the ranks' partials summed in rank order, fp32 ->
+        bf16: the attention output), slice, gate, norm -> the MoE input
+        MoE (stages/moe.py): xq, router (bf16 GEMV, f32 logits), route
+        (sqrtsoftplus + bias, top-k, renormalized x the routed scale; a hash
+        layer's experts given), shared expert (MXFP8 GEMVs, clamped SiLU), ug
+        (MXFP4 x MXFP8 per expert of the step's union), down (+ routing
+        weight, top-k order; + shared) -> push, rank-order sum -> out
+    FFN K2 without the attention back: push of vLLM's unreduced wo_b output,
+        as its bits, to every rank's attention region, then K2's FFN seam and
+        MoE (the same code, `layer.run_ffn`)
+
+## Execution model and hand-offs
+
+- Grid = 256 CTAs (one a CU, all resident), 512 threads a CTA, LDS a per-stage
+  union. A stage is a task table: CTA `b` runs tasks `b, b + 256, ...`, stages
+  in order; a consumer only waits on earlier stages, so no deadlock while the
+  grid is resident. A GEMV task issues its weight loads before it polls its
+  activations.
+- In a launch: tagged pairs (value + tag in one 8 B store) or plain data +
+  flags, at device scope. The tag is the launch pair's epoch (K1 `2e + 1`,
+  K2 or the FFN launch `2e + 2`), a device word their CTA 0 moves on once every
+  CTA has marked the launch done: no clearing between steps, no host step
+  hook, every argument a fixed device pointer (graph-safe). A step width and
+  key-table width have a scratch of their own: under another layout a pair's
+  tag word could be plain data.
+- Across ranks: one symmetric uncached buffer a rank (aiter `UncachedIpcHeap`),
+  every rank holding every peer's address; pushes are system-scope stores of
+  (value, tag) pairs. Every rank runs the same launches, so the epochs agree;
+  peer regions alternate by epoch parity, and a rank cannot run two steps ahead
+  of a peer (each step's reduce waits on every rank's push).
+
+## Numerics
+
+- Seams: V4.1's are aiter's `mhc_fused_post_pre_delayed_rmsnorm` (post fold
+  order, fn as bf16 hi + lo, products summed in order, Triton sigmoid / exp /
+  rcp); V4-Pro's the same gate on its own residual, its collapse aiter's
+  `mhc_pre` (the four streams in fp32 -> bf16, rsq(sum / H + eps), (x w) rstd).
+  The gate matches the fp32 reference; aiter's fused seam is ~2e-3 off it.
+- Attention: activations as MXFP8 (one E8M0 per 32 values, `code =
+  clamp(ceil(log2(amax / 448)) + 127, 0, 254)`): V4.1's vLLM path exactly;
+  V4-Pro's vLLM path quantizes per 128 with fp32 scales, which the kernels
+  match no worse against the exact result. Weights as vLLM loads them: e4m3
+  [N, K] row-major (V4-Pro: rows padded as `VLLM_ROCM_FP8_PADDING` pads them)
+  or in aiter's (16, 16) shuffle (V4-Pro's wqkv / wo_b / shared gate_up), the
+  E8M0 scales as [N/32, K/32] (V4-Pro's 128 x 128 blocks repeated, exact); KV
+  records as vLLM's insert writes them (dims 0..447 e4m3 with a UE8M0 per 64,
+  RoPE dims bf16, 584 B); softmax in base 2 with the attention sink folded in.
+- MoE: vLLM's router (bf16 gate GEMV, f32 logits, `topk_hash_softplus_sqrt`)
+  and AITER a8w4 `fused_moe` (interleaved gate / up, swiglu limit 10, weights
+  in aiter's (16, 16) shuffle and `shuffle_scale` order); the shared expert as
+  MXFP8 linears with `silu_and_mul_with_clamp`.
+- All-reduces (`stages/allreduce.py`): exact, fp32 in rank order -> bf16. One
+  hop (every rank pushes its partial to every rank) or, from
+  `spec.two_hop_rows` rows, two (to the column's owner, which sums and pushes
+  the bf16 sum to the others: 2 / tp of the bytes); bit-identical results.
+
+## Adding a model
+
+A model of the family -- mHC seams, the sparse MLA attention over fp8_ds_mla
+records, a routed MXFP4 MoE with a shared FP8 expert -- needs no kernel code:
+
+1. `MonoSpec` (`spec.py`): its widths (hidden, q rank, heads, output groups,
+   top-k, experts, intermediates), numerics (routed scale, swiglu limit, norm
+   eps), variants (`delayed_seam`, `q_head_norm`, `preshuffled`,

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Geometry of the DeepSeek-V4 family's attention stages (``front``, ``back``):
+the KV record, the split attention's chunks and the scratch (mailbox) layout;
+the model's widths and a TP rank's share of them are ``spec.Dims``."""
+
+from vllm.models.common.amd.mono.spec import (
+    HEAD_DIM,
+    WQKV_KPARTS,
+    Dims,
+)
+
+# KV record (V4 fp8_ds_mla): 576 B data rows (448 e4m3 | 64 bf16), then 8 B of
+# scales a token (7 UE8M0 + pad) after the block's rows
+DATA = 576
+SCALE_BYTES = 8
+
+# attention: a split is 16 keys
+BK = 16
+COLS = 32  # PV columns a group (one MX group of the output)
+GROUPS = HEAD_DIM // COLS  # 16
+
+PAIR = 8  # a mailbox (value, tag) pair
+
+
+def cdiv(a, b):
+    return -(-a // b)
+
+
+def round_up(a, b):
+    return cdiv(a, b) * b
+
+
+def pair_layout(items, start=0, align=256):
+    out, off = {}, start
+    for name, pairs in items:
+        off = round_up(off, align)
+        out[name] = (off, pairs * PAIR)
+        off += pairs * PAIR
+    return out
+
+
+def byte_layout(items, start=0, align=256):
+    out, off = {}, start
+    for name, nbytes in items:
+        off = round_up(off, align)
+        out[name] = (off, nbytes)
+        off += nbytes
+    return out
+
+
+def front_scratch(s: int, d: Dims) -> dict:
+    """K1's scratch regions -> (byte offset, bytes): published data (plain
+    words behind a flag) and mailbox pairs."""
+    return byte_layout(
+        [
+            ("x8", s * d.hidden),  # e4m3 words (S > 16: quantized once, shared)
+            ("x8s", s * d.x_groups * 4),  # an i32 code a group
+            ("xrdy", WQKV_KPARTS * s * PAIR),  # a flag a (token, K half)
+            ("qkvp", WQKV_KPARTS * s * d.qkv_rows * PAIR),
+            ("qx8", s * d.q_rank),  # e4m3 words
+            ("qx8s", s * d.q_rank // 32 * 4),  # an i32 code a group
+            ("qrdy", s * PAIR),
+        ]
+    )
+
+
+def back_scratch(s: int, d: Dims, start: int = 0) -> dict:
+    """K2's scratch regions, laid out past ``start``: published data (plain)
+    and flag pairs."""
+    ck = (
+        64 if d.head_tiles == 2 and s * cdiv(d.keys, 64) <= 256 else 128
+    )  # back.chunk_keys
+    nchunk = cdiv(d.keys, ck)
+    return byte_layout(
+        [
+            ("part", s * nchunk * d.heads * HEAD_DIM * 2),  # bf16 partials
+            ("pstat", s * nchunk * d.heads * 8),  # (max, sum) f32
+            ("srdy", s * nchunk * PAIR),
+            ("xo", s * d.q_rows),  # e4m3 words
+            ("xos", s * d.q_rows // 32 * 4),  # an i32 code a group
+            ("crdy", s * d.heads // 8 * PAIR),
+            ("x8b", s * d.o_rows),
+            ("x8bs", s * d.o_rows // 32 * 4),
+            ("ardy", d.woa_tasks * PAIR),
+        ],
+        start=start,
+    )
+
+
+def front_end(s: int, d: Dims) -> int:
+    """Where K2's regions start: past K1's, which share the launch tag."""
+    return round_up(max(o + n for o, n in front_scratch(s, d).values()), 256)
+
+
+def scratch_bytes(s: int, d: Dims) -> int:
+    b = back_scratch(s, d, start=front_end(s, d))
+    return round_up(max(o + n for o, n in b.values()), 4096)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""vLLM's side of a model's mono decode layer, the parts every model shares:
+the deployment the kernels need, the process's runner of a ``MonoSpec``, a
+decode step's eligibility and its SWA / compressed-cache metadata, and the
+caches as the kernels read them. A model's docking (``MonoDecode`` subclass)
+adds its layer checks, its weights and its layer forward.
+
+Every TP rank must take the same path at every layer (the kernels wait on each
+other's pushes): the conditions here read only metadata every rank holds
+alike."""
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, ClassVar
+
+import torch
+
+import vllm.envs as envs
+from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.distributed import (
+    get_tensor_model_parallel_rank,
+    get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size,
+    get_tp_group,
+)
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context, is_forward_context_available
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.models.common.amd.mono.spec import WINDOW, MonoSpec
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.models.common.amd.mono.runner import MonoRunner
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+RECORD = 584  # an fp8_ds_mla KV record: 576 data bytes, 8 scale bytes
+SWA_WIDTH = WINDOW  # a causal decode token's window slots
+# the kernels' ISA: CDNA4 (gfx950) scaled MFMA and MX formats
+CDNA_VERSIONS = (4,)
+
+_runners: dict[MonoSpec, "MonoRunner"] = {}
+
+
+def mono_runner(
+    spec: MonoSpec, device: torch.device, max_topk: int = 0
+) -> "MonoRunner":
+    """The process's runner of ``spec`` (one a TP rank, shared by every layer;
+    ``max_topk``: its widest key table, ``MonoRunner``). Its peer-memory
+    handshake is collective over the TP group: every rank builds it at the same
+    layer of the same step."""
+    runner = _runners.get(spec)
+    if runner is None:
+        if torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            # its peer memory is allocated and exchanged eagerly; vLLM warms
+            # every graph up eagerly before capturing it
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "--monokernel was first reached inside a CUDA graph "
+                "capture, before an eager decode step."
+            )
+        from vllm.models.common.amd.mono.runner import MonoRunner
+
+        runner = _runners[spec] = MonoRunner(
+            spec,
+            get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size(),
+            get_tensor_model_parallel_rank(),
+            get_tp_group().cpu_group,
+            device,
+            max_topk=max_topk,
+        )
+    return runner
+
+
+def record_view(kv: torch.Tensor, block: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """A layer's fp8_ds_mla cache as [blocks, block, RECORD] bytes (a block's
+    data rows, then its scale words: the kernels index both from it)."""
+    kv = kv if kv.dtype == torch.uint8 else kv.view(torch.uint8)
+    assert kv.stride(0) >= block * RECORD, (tuple(kv.shape), kv.stride(), block)
+    return torch.as_strided(kv, (kv.shape[0], block, RECORD), (kv.stride(0), RECORD, 1))
+
+
+def scale_bytes(scale: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """E8M0 scales as their bytes: a float8_e8m0fnu / uint8 tensor's own, or the
+    exponents of a power-of-two fp32 one (vLLM's aiter linears upcast them)."""
+    if scale.dtype == torch.float32:
+        bits = scale.contiguous().view(torch.int32)
+        code = (bits >> 23).to(torch.uint8)
+        assert torch.equal(bits, code.to(torch.int32) << 23), "not powers of two"
+        return code
+    return scale if scale.dtype == torch.uint8 else scale.view(torch.uint8)
+
+
+def mx_scales(scale: torch.Tensor, block: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``block`` x ``block`` E8M0 weight scales as the kernels' 32 x 32 ones:
+    each code repeated over its block (exact: E8M0 is a power of two)."""
+    codes = scale_bytes(scale)
+    if block == 32:
+        return codes.contiguous()
+    r = block // 32
+    return codes.repeat_interleave(r, 0).repeat_interleave(r, 1).contiguous()
+
+
+def _compute_units() -> int:
+    return current_platform.num_compute_units(torch.accelerator.current_device_index())
+
+
+def unsupported_moe(experts, vllm_config) -> str | None:
+    """Why the kernels cannot run this deployment's MoE, or None. They read every
+    routed expert on each rank, TP-sharded, in AITER's A8W4 MXFP4 layout."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.oracle.mxfp4 import Mxfp4MoeBackend
+
+    pc = vllm_config.parallel_config
+    if pc.enable_expert_parallel or pc.enable_eplb or pc.data_parallel_size > 1:
+        return "needs tensor parallelism only: no expert or data parallelism"
+    if envs.VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE_A4W4_DSV4:
+        return "needs AITER's A8W4 MoE (VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MOE_A4W4_DSV4 unset)"
+    if experts is None:
+        return None  # not a routed MoE: the layer checks decline it
+    backend = getattr(experts.quant_method, "mxfp4_backend", None)
+    if backend != Mxfp4MoeBackend.AITER_MXFP4_BF16:
+        return f"needs the AITER_MXFP4_BF16 MoE backend, not {backend}"
+    return None
+
+
+class MonoDecode:
+    """One decoder layer's mono path: the whole layer or, with ``ffn_only``, the
+    FFN launch after vLLM's attention. A model subclasses it with its ``SPEC``,
+    the TP sizes its kernels take and its layer's hooks."""
+
+    SPEC: ClassVar[MonoSpec]
+    TP_SIZES: ClassVar[tuple[int, ...]]
+    LABEL: ClassVar[str]  # the model, in log lines
+
+    def __init__(self, ffn_only: bool = False, max_topk: int = 0) -> None:
+        self.ffn_only = ffn_only
+        self.max_topk = max_topk  # the widest key table (``MonoRunner``)
+        self._weights: Any = None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def deployment_error(cls, experts, vllm_config) -> str | None:
+        """Why this deployment cannot run the kernels at all, or None (an
+        explicit opt-in that cannot run is an error)."""
+        from vllm.platforms.rocm import get_cdna_version
+
+        if get_cdna_version() not in CDNA_VERSIONS:
+            return f"needs CDNA{'/'.join(map(str, CDNA_VERSIONS))}"
+        tp = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
+        if tp not in cls.TP_SIZES:
+            sizes = " or ".join(map(str, cls.TP_SIZES))
+            return f"needs tensor parallel size {sizes}"
+        why = unsupported_moe(experts, vllm_config)
+        if why is not None:
+            return why
+        try:
+            from vllm.models.common.amd.mono.runner import BLOCKS
+        except ImportError as err:
+            return f"needs FlyDSL and AITER's FlyDSL helpers ({err})"
+        # every CTA of a launch stays resident: a partitioned GPU deadlocks
+        cus = _compute_units()
+        if cus < BLOCKS:
+            return f"needs {BLOCKS} compute units, the GPU has {cus}"
+        return None
+
+    def runner(self, device: torch.device) -> "MonoRunner":
+        return mono_runner(self.SPEC, device, self.max_topk)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def skip(cls, why: str) -> None:
+        logger.debug_once("%s mono decode skipped a step: %s", cls.LABEL, why)
+        return None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def decode_step(cls, swa_prefix: str, comp_prefix: str | None, rows: int):
+        """(why this step takes the original path -- None for a decode-only step
+        the kernels take -- the layer's SWA metadata, its compressed cache's)."""

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""What a model is to the mono kernels: ``MonoSpec``, one model's decoder layer
+(its widths, numerics and seam variant), and ``Dims``, a TP rank's share of it
+with every count the stages derive from it. A build key carries the spec, so a
+kernel reads its model from the key alone; a new model of the family is a new
+``MonoSpec`` (README, "Adding a model")."""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+from vllm.models.common.amd.mono.common.plan import Shard, cdiv, padded
+
+# the family's fixed widths: the mHC seams' streams, the MLA head, the KV record
+HC = 4
+HEAD_DIM = 512
+ROPE = 64
+NOPE = HEAD_DIM - ROPE
+HALF = ROPE // 2
+KV_DIM = HEAD_DIM
+O_RANK = 1024
+WINDOW = 128
+EXPERT_PAD = 128  # the loader pads a routed expert's rank share to this
+ROWS = 16  # GEMV rows a task
+TILE = 16  # tokens a GEMV pass (an MFMA's N)
+HEAD_TILE = 16  # heads an attention MFMA takes
+WOA_ROWS = 32  # a wo_a task's rows: one MX group of its output
+UG_PART = 32  # intermediate columns an ug task part: one FP4 group
+WQKV_KPARTS = 2  # wqkv's K split
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class MonoSpec:
+    """One model's decoder layer, as the kernels read it (scalars only: a build
+    key carries it into FlyDSL's JIT cache key)."""
+
+    name: str  # the kernels' symbol stem
+    hidden: int
+    q_rank: int
+    n_heads: int
+    o_groups: int
+    index_topk: int  # a token's top-k compressed keys at most
+    experts: int
+    topk: int
+    moe_inter: int  # a routed expert's intermediate width
+    shared_inter: int
+    routed_scale: float
+    swiglu_limit: float
+    norm_eps: float  # every RMSNorm's (and the mHC seams')
+    # the mHC seam collapses the layer input with the previous seam's pre-mix
+    # (V4.1) rather than with its own (V4)
+    delayed_seam: bool
+    max_tokens: int  # a step's rows at most
+    # wqkv, wo_b and the shared expert's gate_up in aiter's (16, 16) shuffle
+    # (vLLM preshuffles them in place for its block-scaled GEMMs), else row-major
+    preshuffled: bool = False
+    # a weightless RMSNorm over each query head ahead of the attention (V4)
+    q_head_norm: bool = False
+    # vLLM pads a row-major FP8 weight's rows of a multiple of 512 bytes by 256
+    # (``VLLM_ROCM_FP8_PADDING``: its block-scaled linears), ``Dims.ld``
+    padded_rows: bool = False
+    # the step width from which the all-reduces take two hops
+    # (``stages.allreduce``; 0: one hop always)
+    two_hop_rows: int = 0
+    hc_sinkhorn: int = 20
+    hc_eps: float = 1e-6
+    hc_post_mult: float = 2.0
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Dims:
+    """A TP rank's share of ``spec``: every count a stage derives from the
+    model's widths and the TP size."""
+
+    spec: MonoSpec
+    tp: int
+    # a token's compressed keys at most (0: the model's top-k): a build's
+    # attention over every compressed row of a long context reads more
+    topk: int = 0
+
+    def __post_init__(self):
+        sp, shard = self.spec, Shard(self.tp)
+        shard.split(sp.n_heads, "attention heads")
+        shard.split(sp.o_groups, "output groups")
+        shard.split(sp.moe_inter, "routed intermediate")
+        shard.split(sp.shared_inter, "shared intermediate")
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------ model
+    @property
+    def hidden(self) -> int:
+        return self.spec.hidden
+
+    @property
+    def q_rank(self) -> int:
+        return self.spec.q_rank
+
+    @property
+    def qkv_rows(self) -> int:
+        return self.spec.q_rank + KV_DIM
+
+    @property
+    def x_words(self) -> int:
+        """An MXFP8 hidden row's i32 words."""
+        return self.spec.hidden // 4
+
+    @property
+    def x_groups(self) -> int:
+        """An MXFP8 hidden row's E8M0 groups."""
+        return self.spec.hidden // 32
+
+    def ld(self, k: int) -> int:
+        """The row stride of a row-major FP8 weight of K = ``k`` (bytes)."""
+        return k + 256 if self.spec.padded_rows and k % 512 == 0 else k
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------ attention
+    @property
+    def heads(self) -> int:
+        return self.spec.n_heads // self.tp
+
+    @property
+    def head_tiles(self) -> int:
+        return self.heads // HEAD_TILE
+
+    @property
+    def groups(self) -> int:
+        return self.spec.o_groups // self.tp
+
+    @property
+    def group_k(self) -> int:
+        """wo_a's K a group: its heads' outputs."""
+        return self.heads // self.groups * HEAD_DIM
+
+    @property
+    def o_rows(self) -> int:
+        return self.groups * O_RANK
+
+    @property
+    def q_rows(self) -> int:
+        return self.heads * HEAD_DIM
+
+    @property
+    def wqkv_tasks(self) -> int:
+        return self.qkv_rows // ROWS
+
+    @property
+    def wqb_tasks(self) -> int:
+        return self.q_rows // ROWS
+
+    @property
+    def woa_tasks(self) -> int:
+        return self.o_rows // WOA_ROWS
+
+    @property
+    def wob_tasks(self) -> int:
+        return self.spec.hidden // ROWS
+
+    @property
+    def topk_width(self) -> int:
+        """A token's compressed keys at most."""
+        return self.topk or self.spec.index_topk
+
+    @property
+    def keys(self) -> int:
+        """A token's attention keys at most: its top-k, then its window."""
+        return self.topk_width + WINDOW
+
+    # ------------------------------------------------------------ MoE
+    @property
+    def inter_real(self) -> int:
+        """A routed expert's real intermediate width on this rank."""
+        return self.spec.moe_inter // self.tp
+
+    @property
+    def inter(self) -> int:
+        """... padded as the loader pads it (the rest zero weights)."""
+        return padded(self.inter_real, EXPERT_PAD)
+
+    @property
+    def sh_inter(self) -> int:
+        """The shared expert's intermediate width on this rank."""
+        return self.spec.shared_inter // self.tp
+
+    @property
+    def shared_tasks(self) -> int:
+        return self.sh_inter // ROWS
+
+    @property
+    def mid_words(self) -> int:
+        """MXFP8 words of a pick's routed intermediate."""
+        return self.inter // 4
+
+    @property
+    def down_scale_cols(self) -> int:
+        """w2_s's e8m0 columns: inter / 32, padded to a multiple of 8
+        (aiter ``shuffle_scale``)."""
+        return padded(self.inter // 32, 8)
+
+    @property
+    def down_tasks(self) -> int:
+        return self.spec.hidden // ROWS
+
+
+def token_tiles(s):
+    """A step's tokens in GEMV passes: [(first token, tokens)]. A GEMV loads its
+    weights once and runs every pass on them, an x tile in LDS at a time."""
+    return [(t0, min(TILE, s - t0)) for t0 in range(0, s, TILE)]
+
+
+def tile_rows(s):
+    """The LDS rows an x tile holds."""
+    return min(s, TILE)
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "EXPERT_PAD",
+    "HALF",
+    "HC",
+    "HEAD_DIM",
+    "HEAD_TILE",
+    "KV_DIM",
+    "NOPE",
+    "O_RANK",
+    "ROPE",
+    "ROWS",
+    "TILE",
+    "UG_PART",
+    "WINDOW",
+    "WOA_ROWS",
+    "WQKV_KPARTS",
+    "Dims",
+    "MonoSpec",
+    "cdiv",
+    "tile_rows",
+    "token_tiles",
+]
